dt: Mandatory letter of intent any time; FOA open to July 18, 2029
e: Grants and cooperative agreements with U.S. colleges and universities for directed-energy research. Topics include solid-state and fiber lasers, beam control, optical components and coatings, adaptive optics, free-space quantum communication and networking, and high-power microwaves. Only accredited U.S. degree-granting institutions may apply, and a letter of intent is required before any application.
n: AFRL Directed Energy Directorate: University Assistance Instruments (RDK-RAD-FOA-2024)
